name: 見逃し記事の右写真リスト
prompt:
Create a standalone Japanese editorial saved-articles list at the exact proportions of the source region (1061 x 879 px). Use a white background and a thin light-gray top rule. Near the top left place a compact bold section label. Then show two stacked article rows separated by a thin light-gray divider. Each row has a bold dark Japanese headline on the left, a muted gray reading-time line below it, and a square thumbnail on the right. Match the native preview for exact wording, compact Japanese sans-serif typography, and clear hierarchy; use the source crop for overall row spacing.
Section label, exactly:
見逃した記事をチェック

First headline, exactly on two lines:
海と共に生きる
地域の挑戦

First reading time:
読了まで4分

Second headline, exactly on two lines:
未来の暮らしを
みんなで考える

Second reading time:
読了まで4分

Place the first square thumbnail at x=773,y=126,size=288x288 and the second at x=773,y=524,size=288x288. Use the supplied exact oil-platform and underwater photographs; do not invent, crop, recolor, or alter them. Leave the rows' white space clean, and include no article summaries, buttons, icons, or additional text.
reviewNotes: v001を目視確認して候補登録。日本語プレビューのセクション名・2件の見出し・読了時間を反映。2枚の写真は確認済みの288×288元アセットを元の位置に無損失合成し、各全画素差分0。候補は参照領域の1061×879に一致。ネイティブ実装の承認とは別。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
